instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: Helix Labs is a diversified holding company operating across industrial packaging, specialty chemicals, and food ingredients. With a portfolio of six distinct operating companies, the group manages complex compliance requirements spanning multiple jurisdictions. The central corporate team is focused on navigating regulatory shifts while balancing core operational efficiency.
answers.pastInitiatives: We successfully deployed a new CRM system across the sales team 18 months ago, which improved lead tracking and reduced pipeline data entry time by 30%. Building on this success, we are now exploring marketing automation integration and AI-assisted lead scoring, aiming to streamline the existing customer acquisition channels.
answers.strategicGoals: We are heavily dependent on a single product category and a concentrated customer base — our top 3 clients represent 55% of revenue. This concentration risk is unacceptable for our long-term health. We need to identify and develop new revenue streams, possibly including new product lines for different customer segments or entirely new business models that leverage our existing capabilities.
answers.additionalContext: We are planning an IPO within 24 months and need to demonstrate a track record of innovation-driven growth to public market investors. The CFO has asked for a 3-year innovation investment plan with clear KPIs that can be included in our equity story and analyst presentations. Bonus points for initiatives that improve our ESG metrics, as this is a key focus area for the listing venue.
answers.teamSize: The innovation function is informal — one senior engineer has been given permission to spend 20% of their time exploring new technologies and prototyping ideas, but this allocation is frequently interrupted by production incidents and urgent feature requests. We have no dedicated innovation budget beyond standard cloud infrastructure costs.

opportunities.title: Sustainable Packaging Solutions Division
opportunities.rationale: Leverage existing chemical and packaging expertise to develop eco-friendly bioplastics or recycled material lines, aligning with growing regulatory pressure on sustainability (ESG). This is a lower risk entry point that utilizes current core competencies.

first_actions: Form a cross-functional task force (R&D, Finance) to assess material feasibility.
Allocate $50k from the innovation budget for initial pilot testing and regulatory screening.
execution_plan.success_metric: Achieve 10% market penetration in organic/recycled packaging within 18 months.
milestones: Q3: Feasibility study completed and technology selection made.
Q4: Secure initial ESG certification for new product line.

opportunities.title: B2B Specialty Chemical SaaS Platform
opportunities.rationale: Develop a modular software platform that automates regulatory compliance and supply chain management for our B2B specialty chemical clients. This diversification moves the company from selling physical goods to selling high-value digital services, creating an entirely new revenue stream.

first_actions: Conduct market validation interviews with three non-core chemical firms.
Identify a core team member (talent gap) for platform architecture.
Conduct regulatory compliance review with legal team to ensure alignment with applicable regulations
resources_needed: Investment in cloud infrastructure and initial UX/UI development
execution_plan.success_metric: Secure 5 paying anchor clients using the platform within the first year.
milestones: Q3: MVP (Minimum Viable Product) prototype ready for closed beta.
Q4: Launch initial subscription tier and secure 10 revenue stream contracts.

next_steps.action: Establish a formal Innovation Governance Committee with clear KPIs tied to diversification success.
Conduct an external talent assessment and develop a targeted retention plan for the 'talent' barrier, focusing on technical strategy expertise.
Prioritize and secure seed funding specifically for the radical SaaS platform exploration phase.

key_weaknesses: Lack of dedicated innovation budget (10% limits scope)
Weak integration between existing digital tools leading to ad-hoc processes.
High regulatory burden creates friction and slows down rapid diversification testing.
